## Summary
Provide a clear and concise description of the feature you’re requesting.

## Problem / Motivation
Explain why this feature is needed.  
What problem does it solve?  
Why is it valuable?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you think the feature should work.  
Include any relevant details, examples, or expected behavior.

## Alternatives Considered
List any alternative approaches you’ve thought about.

## Additional Context
Add any extra information, screenshots, or references that help explain the request.
